issues: ISSUE-T012-1 (closed in this card, measurement root cause): p95 <= 500ms missed in both full-suite parallel runs (527.4ms run A, 649.2ms run B) because 2 Playwright workers shared 1.5 vCPU. Fix: split E2E into `functional` (20 tests) and `perf` (1 test) Playwright projects; `npm run test:e2e` now runs functional only, `npm run test:e2e:perf` runs the perf test alone with a single worker. Isolated serial measurement: p95 257.5ms (n=30, min 162.6, p50 192.5, max 259.5) — PASS with ~1.94x margin, consistent with standalone runs 263.2/282.8ms and the Node kernel 109.7ms. Same 32x12 table, same 30-run method, same 500ms threshold and assertion; only the measurement isolation changed. All five earlier datasets preserved verbatim in T012-performance.json; verdict rewritten to PASS with the full-suite overshoots retained and explained as measurement contamination.

ISSUE-T012-2 (P2, open, for T013): the Cancel button is unobservable in the real browser: analyze() is synchronous on the main thread (async signature, no real await), so React batches ANALYZING true->false into one render. 3 in-page 1ms-poll probes all observed clicked=false. Out of scope for this card. Re-test after Worker wiring (T013).
